args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Items:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Portable power bank

Clothing:
- Swimwear (at least 2 sets)
- Light, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals/flip flops
- Hat/cap for sun protection
- Sunglasses

Beach Day (Waikiki Beach - June 11):
- Beach towel
- Beach bag
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkel gear (or plan to rent)

Snorkeling at Hanauma Bay (June 12):
- Rash guard/swim shirt
- Water shoes
- Underwater camera (optional)

Hiking at Diamond Head (June 13):
- Sturdy hiking shoes
- Hiking socks
- Lightweight backpack
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen (reef-safe)
- Insect repellent

Pearl Harbor Visit (June 14):
- Respectful attire (covered shoulders, no shorts)

North Shore Road Trip (June 15):
- Car adapter for charging devices
- Cooler for drinks/snacks
- Extra water bottles

Luau Experience (June 16):
- Hawaiian shirt or aloha wear (optional but fun)
- Light jacket for evening

Hotel Spa Day (June 17):
- Spa-appropriate swimwear
- Flip flops

Kayaking at Kailua Beach (June 18):
- Quick-dry clothing
- Waterproof bag for valuables

Shopping at Ala Moana Center (June 19):
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Reusable shopping bags

General Items:
- Reef-safe sunscreen (minimum SPF 30)
- Aloe vera gel (for sunburns)
- Basic first aid kit
- Motion sickness medication (for boat activities)
- Prescription medications
- Toiletries
- Hairbrush/comb
- Lip balm with SPF
- Hand sanitizer
- Face masks (if required)
- Travel pillow
- Books/e-reader for downtime
- Snacks for travel days
